notes.title: Starbear: Taxi is 50% Off During the Steam Racing Fest Sale!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32705960/29a8bd781aac2bb9b5408cda29e56e7cd4565ab0.png[/img]

Starbear Taxi will be 50% off for a limited time during the Steam Racing Fest!

Race a spaceship taxi around Starbear’s tiny, futuristic city to deliver busy bear passengers to their desired destinations before the clock runs out! Be wary of the sneaky bandit raccoons who will try to impede your progress toward earning the highest score by collecting honeycombs!

The Steam Racing Fest ends on May 30th!

notes.title: Patch 2
notes.content:
♫ [i]FRESH DAY FRESH PATCH[/i] ♫

Just a small patch to fix a few issues and tweak some balancing. Full notes below, let us know if you find any problems.

[b]Discord: https://discord.gg/QF9qyp[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32705960/31cd0c7d9fbc21624eb7a583d13de28c7681219b.png[/img]

[b]Changelist[/b]
[list]
[*] fix: ship disappearing issue
[*] fix: ship stops turning issue
[*] fix: coin deletion rare errors
[*] fix: bear sleep zzz particles not showing
[*] fix: bullet hell honey pickup sfx not playing
[*] balance: magnet bandit pull amount reduced
[*] balance: magnet bandit pull start delay increased
[*] balance: honeypot time reward reduced slightly
[*] balance: difficulty increase slightly more at high score values
[*] balance: damage time penalty increase as time goes on
[*] balance: reduce haptics for wmr/oculus
[*] justice: released bear hostages
[/list]


BEAR OUT
